sort_tap.why: Tap-to-move sort: goal readable in 3 s, fair fails; huge 2025-26 sort wave

jam_tap.why: Tap vehicles/people out of a jam: instant read, strong near-miss retry; bus/car jam clones in the hundreds

loop_tap.why: Tap items onto a moving loop/conveyor: newer 2025-26 twist on jam/sort, still few top entrants

arrow_tap.why: Tap arrows to escape the grid: one-gesture logic, cheap to build; wave now mid-to-late with many copies

yarn_tap.why: Tap-to-sort yarn/rope: satisfying unwind; 280+ wool/knit releases in Jan-Jul 2025

screw_tap.why: Tap screws/bolts off a board: clear goal, continue-friendly; screw genre saturated

pixel_tap.why: Tap shooters/gems to fill pixel art: picture payoff sells the ad; Pixel Flow-style wave is young

blast_tap.why: Tap-to-blast colour groups: easiest input, deep IAP; blast genre crowded by big publishers

tile_tap.why: Tap tiles/items into a triple tray: instant read; triple-match is saturated

logic_tap.why: Tap-only logic grid: simple input but needs thinking, weaker 3-second hook; cosy-logic (doku) wave is early

word_tap.why: Tap letters/tiles to make words: literate, slower hook; mature word genre

rotate_tap.why: Tap to rotate rings into place: one gesture, clear goal; young format

riddle_multi.why: Trick riddles mix tap, drag, tilt and swipe per level: funny hook but 3+ input types

block_drag.why: Drag pieces onto a grid: classic one-gesture block puzzle; hundreds of clones, ad-led monetisation

slide_drag.why: Slide coloured blocks out of the board (Color Block Jam style): drag-only, proven block+jam combo

goods_drag.why: Drag goods between shelves to triple-match: tidy-up appeal; goods-sort clones are everywhere

hex_drag.why: Drag hex stacks to merge colours: satisfying but saturated hexa-sort

sand_drag.why: Drag blocks that melt into sand: very ad-able physics payoff; sand wave still early

hole_drag.why: Drag a hole to swallow the world: iconic hook; 215 hole clones in Jan-Jul 2025

io_drag.why: Swipe to steer and claim territory: instant hook, ad-led, very mature .io format

runner_swipe.why: Swipe-only endless runner: great hook, but heavy 3D production and a saturated genre

rhythm_tap.why: Tap to the beat: instant hook but timing skill; music licensing raises cost

physics_tap.why: Tap to trigger physics smashes: satisfying destruction, aim/timing adds complexity

match3_swipe.why: Swipe-to-swap match-3: proven IAP depth, but huge live-ops cost and a market owned by King/Dream/Playrix

match3_meta.why: Swipe match-3 feeding a decorate/build meta: deepest monetisation, very expensive to compete

merge2.why: Merge-2: tap generators plus drag-to-merge on the core board (one drag-to-merge input, no cap); strong IAP but costly content

mahjong_tap.why: Tap matching pairs: easy input, needs scanning; classic, no growth wave

classic_board.why: Classic board game: tap-only but no twist to own; theme and monetisation are thin

hidden_tap.why: Tap to find hidden objects: simple input, slower 3-second read; art-heavy content

color_tap.why: Tap-to-colour by number: zero learning curve, relaxing; low retry tension

bubble_tap.why: Aim-and-tap bubble shooter: one gesture with aiming; old saturated genre

snake_swipe.why: Swipe a stretching cat to fill the board: elegant one-gesture puzzle, cheap to build

asmr_multi.why: ASMR toy/unboxing: very satisfying ad hook, but each toy uses a different gesture (tap, drag, swipe, hold) and depth is thin

minigame_multi.why: Bundle of mini-games with different controls: broad appeal but no single core loop

idle_tap.why: Tap-to-earn idle clicker: easiest input, slow hook, ad/IAP friendly

cash_skill.why: Real-money skill tournaments: regulated, payments and anti-fraud make it a poor fit for us

social_casino.why: Tap-to-spin social casino with a build meta: huge IAP, but big-budget UA and regulation risk

drop_tap.why: Tap to drop coins/balls and watch them bounce: plinko-style payoff, shallow progression

flip_tap.why: One-tap timing flip: hypercasual hook, thin depth and ad-only economy

aim_drag.why: Drag to aim and shoot: simple but generic duel shooter

cube3d.why: Tap cubes away but swipe to rotate the 3D shape: distinct tap AND swipe are both core, so capped

adventure_multi.why: 3D adventure with joystick plus tap actions: multi-input, IP-led, expensive

licensed_kids.why: Licensed kids playground: many gestures, value comes from the IP not the mechanic

farm_multi.why: Farm/town builder: tap to build plus swipe to harvest and pan; deep but very costly

pvp_match3.why: Swipe match-3 with PvP battles: two cores compete for attention

itch_platformer.why: Keyboard platformer/action puzzle (move + jump + action): 3+ inputs, not a mobile fit

itch_grid.why: Grid-move puzzle (arrow keys/swipe only): clean single input, niche hook

itch_logic.why: Tap-only logic puzzle (nonogram/deduction): simple input, slow hook

itch_tap.why: One-tap arcade/luck toy: easiest input, little depth

itch_drag.why: Drag-to-place puzzle: single gesture, niche concept

itch_story.why: Point-and-click story/sim: tap-only, but the joke or story is the product

itch_merge.why: Small merge puzzle: drag-only, proven loop in miniature
